site: Any run started with a signal path that lacks '_signal_' (Datadog audit run)
class: A derived file name could equal its source name, so the run wrote over its own input
symptom: The review stop kept resuming by itself: wait_for_signal wrote its 'waiting' timestamp into the signal file and read it back as an instruction.
root_cause: waiting_note_for replaced '_signal_' with '_waiting_'; with no '_signal_' in the name the path came back unchanged.
why_tests_missed: Only dashboard-made names (which always contain '_signal_') were ever used.
fix: When the replacement leaves the name unchanged, the note is '_waiting_' + the name, in the same folder.
prevention: A path derived from another is checked to differ from it before anything is written.
